lead108_ladder_shift_vs_served_ll_wk2_9.notes: Scored 2026-11-15 by scripts/lead108_wording_mixture.py. Expected-lineup shift = sum of LEAD-110 signed spread points per Out x (1 - P_play), home minus away. Read coverage: weeks 2-8 are LEAD-106 sampled reads (7-40% of value mass per week), week 9 full forward reads. Served base = last published card probability before the deadline because 2026 is absent from pick_probability per_game. Fitted slopes small and fold-unstable (ladder 3 of 8 folds negative, read 2 of 8).
lead108_ladder_shift_vs_served_ll_wk2_9.plain_summary: Adding a tag-weighted missing-player term to the published pick probability did not improve it this season so far.
